feedback.problem:
Negate the following statement:

$\,$ All rational numbers are positive.
feedback.worked_solution:
The given statement can be re-phrased as follows:

$\,$ For all $x\in Q,$ $x$ is positive.

Introducing the universal quantifier, we get the following:

$\,$ $∀x\in Q,\,x\text{ is positive}.$

Negating this, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(∀x\in Q,\,x\text{ is positive}) & ≡∃x\in Q,\,¬(x\text{ is positive}) \\  & ≡∃x\in Q,\,x\text{ is not positive}\end{aligned}
$$

which reads 

$\,$ There exists $x\in Q$ such that $x$ is not positive.

or simply

$\,$ At least one rational number is not positive.

submitted_fields.submitted_value: At least one rational number is not positive.
